title: LiveLayer
description: An org's live layer at a head revision (02-lld §3.1, §8.3): what running work is narrowed by while it runs. Each member of `layers` is a policy layer of kind `live` holding only what narrows, for every run of the org or, with `agentKey`, for that agent's runs; several may name the same agent (the deployment's rules, the org's). A worker folds them under a run's pin with meet on every ceiling, so a value looser than the pin changes nothing (NFR-24) and a stricter one applies within the propagation bound (NFR-23). Answered by GET /api/v1/agent-harness/internal/control-plane/orgs/{orgId}/live; a change event names the org and its new revision, never these values, so a holder reloads from the route. Never holds a secret or an approver.

revision.description: The org head revision the layer reflects.

websites.description: Allowed websites (WP-63) as the deployment's, the org's and each agent's layers hold them: the worker folds them at each engine turn (the deployment's caps, the org's lists, an agent's narrows). Kept apart, not met as ceilings: an org that lists nothing allows nothing, while a deployment that lists nothing caps nothing. Absent: no layer sets any.

agents.description: Agent key -> that agent's own section.

revokedBindings.description: Bindings revoked since their runs were pinned (CPD-8 fills it).

repositories.description: Allowed git hosts for repository_fetch (WP-63 part A) as the deployment's cap (HARNESS_ALLOWED_REPOSITORIES_CAP), the org's list and each agent's narrowing hold them: the worker folds them at each call (the cap holds the org's, an agent's narrows those). Kept apart: an org that saved an empty list allows nothing, a deployment that lists nothing caps nothing. An org absent here never saved its git hosts: a run with web access gets the release's default presets (ADR-REPO-01), one without none.

agents.description: Agent key -> that agent's own section.

agentKey.description: The agent whose runs the layer narrows; absent: every run of the org.
